Genesect

Bug Steel

Unova · Generation 5 · Mythical Pokémon

Genesect is a Bug/Steel-type Paleozoic Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 82.5 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 600.
